body_html:
The Craft Half Round 40" Unit turns open floor space into an inviting place to gather. Part of Global Furniture Group's fully upholstered modular lounge collection, this non-handed half-round piece pairs with other Craft shapes to build casual meeting and reception settings that flex with your space. Soft, durable, and endlessly reconfigurable, it brings warmth to lobbies, break-out zones, and collaborative commons.

Features

  • Modular non-handed component reconfigures freely — ideal for open collaborative spaces
  • Half-round geometry combines with other Craft shapes for infinite layout possibilities
  • Fully upholstered seat for comfortable soft seating
  • Standard with 1.5" tall nylon glides
  • Optional dual-wheel carpet (C107) or hard-floor (C107R) casters
  • Available in Grade 1 seating textiles, LuxHide, and graded-in or GPM textiles

Specifications

Overall dimensions 40"W x 21"D x 17.5"H with a 17.5" seat height; unit weight 33 lbs. GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold certified and proudly made in Canada.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (since 1964) and an OECM-eligible supplier, so Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote below or call 1-800-835-9565 to spec your Craft lounge configuration.
